### Describe the Bug
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '....'
3. Scroll down to '....'
4. See error

### Expected Behavior
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

### Current Behavior
What actually happened instead.

### Screenshots / Screen Recordings
If applicable, add visual recordings or screenshots to explain the issue.

### Environment & Device
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14.2, Windows 11, Ubuntu 22.04, iOS, Android]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 124, Safari 17, Firefox 125]
- Screen Resolution / Viewport: [e.g. Desktop 1920x1080, Mobile 375x667]

### Additional Context
Add any other context about the problem here (e.g. localStorage state, console errors).
